ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones are localized on the outer lateral regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a central wedge originating at the peduncle and extending to the median notch. Dense, irregular black mottling and solid bands dominate the entire trailing edge margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 110 degrees and a distinct vertical pixel depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with the most pronounced jaggedness occurring towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a symmetrical concave curvature toward the tips; trailing edges follow a broadly convex trajectory heavily modified by serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, raised yellowish-white pixels (barnacle colonization) are visible on the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent vertical low-intensity linear mark bisects the white patch on the left lobe. A series of short, parallel vertical 'rake' marks are visible on the lower central fluke near the peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle encrustation on the distal tips and irregular, jagged degradation of the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, long vertical black mark on the interior white field of the left lobe serves as a unique visual identifier.
